Fund News & Trends.title: How David Booth Built Dimensional From A Brooklyn Brownstone
Fund News & Trends.summary: David Booth started Dimensional Fund Advisors out of a Brooklyn brownstone in 1981 with an idea that challenged conventional investing: investors should have exposure to smaller companies as part of a diversified portfolio. More than four decades later, Dimensional manages over $1 trillion. Booth is on this week's episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations to discuss how he built Dimensional and the investment philosophy behind the firm. This interview was recorded August 1

Dimensional Fund Advisors Founder and Chairman David Booth explains his investment philosophy of staying calm during periods of market volatility. This interview was recorded August 10 in New York.
